BiblicalUsage: maphtêach is a key, an opener. In Isaiah 22:22 the key of the house of David is laid on Eliakim's shoulder, so he shall open and none shall shut, and shut and none shall open. In Judges 3:25 the servants take a key and open the doors of the parlour to find their lord fallen dead., and a key in Scripture is authority, not only iron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe maphtêach shows me that the right key belongs to the house of David, and I hold that Christ holds it now, opening doors no man can shut.
